_comment: Corpus sample registry and contract regression expectations. Drop <id>.png into inbox/ and run `npm run prototype:strip:corpus`. contract_expect is PASS | REVIEW | FAIL under the production tri-state runtime — update only when the contract changes. contract_expect_gates names Review-band gates for REVIEW rows and hard-fail gates for FAIL rows. Pre-generation predictions are frozen in prediction-ledger.json.
